messages:
IncidentBot: pager triggered — elevated 502/504 rates observed at apigw-prod-us-east-1. Threshold: 5xx rate > 3% for 3m. Alert ID: INC-6154321987 :rotating_light:
Maya Chen: I'm on it. Can someone confirm blast radius? seeing spike from edge->gateway paths in telemetry.
Ajay Patel: Confirmed — spikes started ~90s ago. 502s concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat routes.
Carlos Rivera: Adding traces. Looks like upstream timeouts from model-routing service (model-router) to pool-3 replicas.
Priya Singh: @Evan Thomas are you the oncall?
Evan Thomas: yes, taking. what is current error rate?
IncidentBot: Current 5xx rate (1m): 6.8%; 5m: 4.9%. P50 latency normal, tail latency rising.
Jenna Park: CS has an open ticket with a big customer complaining of failed calls to our API and UI falling back to spinner. tagging customer-critical.
Maya Chen: OK priority: 1) stabilize traffic (circuit-break / fallback), 2) route around bad upstream, 3) assess customer impact.
Ajay Patel: I'm enabling circuit breaker on apigw for model-router backend for 15s window to let caches handle load. Command: `redwoodctl apigw set-circuit model-router --window=15s --threshold=0.05`
Carlos Rivera: Also increasing edge retry budget to 1 retry with backoff to short-circuit 502s -> `edge-config: retry_count: 1, backoff_ms: 200`
Evan Thomas: Doing the circuit-break change now. Pushing to prod via `infraops` job.
IncidentBot: action executed: circuit-break toggled for model-router on apigw-prod-us-east-1.
Maya Chen: Good. Can we push a fallback model variant for the heavy routes to reduce latency?
Carlos Rivera: We can route /v1/generate to cached-quantized variant for low-latency until router recovers. Applying route policy now.
Ajay Patel: Patch applied: traffic split 80% cached-quantized, 20% model-router. Monitoring.
IncidentBot: traffic split change recorded.
Jenna Park: Notified affected customer CUST-998 via support channel — they saw 502s starting ~11:12am PST. We'll follow up if impact persists.
Priya Singh: Any sign this is capacity or a bug?
Carlos Rivera: Initial traces show model-router instances returning 504s due to internal connection pool starvation — likely a resource leak on pool-3.
Maya Chen: Can we scale model-router replicas as short-term mitigation?
Evan Thomas: Triggering horizontal scale + temporary increase to connection pool. `k scale deploy/model-router --replicas=12`
Ajay Patel: Scaling triggered. Also dropping verbose logging to reduce IO pressure: `LOG_LEVEL=model_router=warn`
IncidentBot: scale job started; expected ready in ~45s.
Maya Chen: After circuit-break + routing changes, 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% (1m). Good sign.
Carlos Rivera: Still seeing sporadic 502s from a small subset of instances: ip-10-2-*. Will cordon and repro one.
Evan Thomas: Cordoning instance ip-10-2-77 and draining.
Ajay Patel: Drained. New requests rerouted.
IncidentBot: instance ip-10-2-77 removed from pool; health checks now pass for rest.
Jenna Park: Customer CUST-998 reports partial recovery — now seeing successful calls but slower than normal.
Priya Singh: Recommend post-incident note to CS with timeline + mitigations. Jenna can you draft?
Jenna Park: On it. I'll include observed error windows, affected endpoints, and mitigation steps.
Maya Chen: Next: plan for permanent fix — suspect connection pooling bug in model-router code. Carlos, can you open a P0 bug and assign to router lead?
Carlos Rivera: Created BUG-8432: model-router connection-pool leak under tail-load. Assigned to @Priya Singh for triage and eng task.
Priya Singh: I'll take lead. Will reproduce locally and plan rollback patch.
Evan Thomas: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then transition to normal oncall.
Ajay Patel: Before handoff, recommend keeping the temporary traffic split and circuit-break for another 1h and watch SLOs.
Maya Chen: Agreed. I'll start the incident timeline for the postmortem and tag the eval suites to check for regressions.
Carlos Rivera: Logs collected: attaching snippet to incident doc for triage:
```
[2026-03-15T18:12:34Z] model-router: connection pool timeout after 250ms wait, active=1024, queued=192
[2026-03-15T18:12:35Z] upstream: 504 gateway_timeout from model-backend-7
[2026-03-15T18:12:36Z] apigw: returning 502 to client for /v1/generate
```
Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll keep the channel open for status updates. Evan, handoff ETA?
Evan Thomas: Handoff in 35m if metrics remain stable.
IncidentBot: incident status: mitigation active, P1 -> under control. Record final actions and open postmortem within 72h.
Maya Chen: Closing active page rotation. If any regression, reopen and @channel. :thumbsup:
